metadata.title: Journals
metadata.description: Browse the journals that {inst} researchers publish in, with open access shares, applicable deals and publication costs.

landing.loadError: The institution list is unavailable. Check that the backend is running.
landing.intro: Choose your institution to browse its journal deals and publication data.
landing.valueLine: Open data, open code: every number links to the open source it came from.
landing.feature1Body: See which transformative agreements waive or discount APCs for your authors.
landing.feature2Body: Inspect where your university publishes, across journals, publishers, faculties, and funders.
landing.feature3Body: Built from OpenAlex, OpenAIRE, ROR, DOAJ, OpenAPC, and Jisc Open Policy Finder.

hero.title: Find the best home for your next article
hero.intro: Search journals to see whether they are covered by an open access deal, what publishing there costs, and how the {institution} publishes in them.
hero.modeGuideIntro: Paste your title and abstract to get ranked open access journal recommendations tailored to your funder, deal coverage, and budget.

onboarding.title: New to the {short} journal browser? Three ways to start:
onboarding.step1Body: Search by title, ISSN, or topic and filter by deal coverage, OA model, or APC.
onboarding.step2Body: Paste your paper's title and abstract for tailored journal recommendations.

search.placeholder: Search journals, ISSNs, publishers, or topics
search.placeholderSemantic: Describe your topic, or paste an abstract
search.scopeTitle: Which field the query matches: everything, journal title, publisher, or topic
search.semanticTitle: Ranks journals by meaning instead of exact words. Filters and sorting are off in this mode.

toolbar.sortTitle: Order of the results. Match by meaning always ranks by similarity instead.
toolbar.resetTitle: Clears the search text and all active filters.
toolbar.semanticStatusActive: Ranked by meaning. Filters and sorting are off in this mode.
toolbar.semanticStatusPending: Match by meaning activates once the query has two characters. Regular search runs until then.

table.sortHint: Click to sort. Click again to reverse. Click again to reset.
table.worksTitle: {inst} works in this journal{windowStart, select, none {} other { from {windowStart} onwards}}{yearRange, select, none {} other { ({yearRange})}}.
table.pubTypeTooltip: This is an OpenAlex {type}, not a conventional journal
table.doajTooltip: Listed in DOAJ, the authoritative registry of gold and diamond open access journals
table.citednessTooltip: 2-year mean citedness from OpenAlex. This is the average number of citations that the journal's works from the last two years have received.
table.apcTooltip: Article processing charge (APC). This is the journal's list price from OpenAlex where the price is known. When it is not, this is the range of APCs that institutions reported to OpenAPC in the two newest reporting periods.
table.topicTooltip: Primary OpenAlex topic of the journal's works.
table.fuzzy: No exact matches for “{query}”. Showing close name matches.
